notes.title: Patch Notes - The Red Odyssey 24/08/2016!
notes.notes:
[h1]Mission Tuning[/h1]
[*][b]CH02 Mission[/b] - Stop bug that could cause unlimited spawning of hunters and reduce enemies in the waves to make less difficult at medium and higher difficulties.
[*][b]CH03 Mission[/b] - Fixed howitzers to work as intended and fixed mine field to be effective against player
[*][b]CH04 Mission[/b] - Add an abandoned enemy ship to make the retreat after discovery possible.
[*][b]CH08 Mission[/b] - Adds time to end so final VO completes
[*][b]CH09 Mission[/b] - Reduce difficulty.  The longer cover is maintained, the fewer enemies spawned when cover is finally left.  Enemies turrets also became single weapon turrets
[*][b]BD02 Mission[/b] - Reduced difficulty.
[*][b]BD03 Mission[/b] - Difficulty tuned, and several object spawning on top of each other issues fixed.
[*][b]BD04 Mission[/b] - Startup issues fixed.  Scavenger's shouldn't leave early which made it hard for new players to follow them. Final chase made more survivable while leaving the epic chase feeling intact.
[*][b]BD06 Mission[/b] - Enemy attack waves slightly reduced[/list]
[h1]General[/h1]
[list][*]A number of minor model fixes applied
[*]Fixed error with point lights.  Weapon fire shouldn't cause strange reverse shadows anymore.
[*]Chinese Scavenger emissive fixed (strange glow removed)
[*]TRO Music Added to game, and TRO missions play TRO sound files
[*]Fury hybrids no longer describe themselves as scavengers
[*]Black Dog weapon properly rotates only top to shoot now.
[*]CVHAUL adjusted how it holds items so it can't levitate itself
[*]Fixes BD constructor's description text.
[*]Non-playing sounds for several vehicles such as CH Constructor fixed.
[*]Fixed the CVAPC cockpit[/list]

[h1]The Patch also includes[/h1][list]
[*]Mod samples in Edit Mode fixed to be present and useful samples [/list]
